result.stance: Adversary position, measured on f8f7a8a51 (origin/main, r.218). The Training gate has three conditions — "all three finished; hits, misses, rounds and time stored; the magazine picture matches the rounds" — and on the deck as it stands only the third is checkable. The obvious rows (copy CL.01–.03 and call them Training) invent three things he did not say: that TRAIN UP has a START and a clock (it has neither — the delta's CL.01 sentence describes TRAIN DOWN, r.197; his own words at asks:87 say "TRAIN UP (a hit target returns in 3 s, mark ends on the hit)"); that "rounds" is on the record (the TIME row carries ms/hits/misses only, and the COLD row's `rounds` is the programme's 40 by construction, lapses included — not rounds spent); and that anything is "stored" (state.events dies with the tab; the IndexedDB store holds telemetry samples, not rows). I do not reopen the delta's decisions — Range only, Qual 40 is Training, Advance is Mix/Leak/Loss all stand — but I correct two of its System Metrics where the deck proves them unmeasurable, and I add the rows that make the gate readable from the record. Input ID is {Sub-CRS}.IN and Output ID is {Sub-CRS}.OUT on every row below, per the format doc. No play.html change, no station move, no coordinate. Existing shipped primitives are reused by name (DRN-05.07 the two-authority shot, DRN-05.08 the three modes, DRN-06.01 the decision record and replay hash), never rebuilt. Four things are left as his word rather than filled.

rows.requirement: TRAIN UP has no run bounds on the record: no START row, no clock, no end — a hit target returns in 3 s (RETURN_S) and the drill runs until RESET. Hits and misses are HIT/MISS rows since the last RESET row; rounds spent is their count. Until what FINISHES TRAIN UP is named, the Training line cannot read it finished and cannot store a time for it. CL.01's sentence 'light WAIT until START; last target down stops the clock' is TRAIN DOWN's mechanics (r.197), not TRAIN UP's.
rows.systemMetric: On the Range in bounce: zero START rows and zero TIME rows after any number of shots (play.html:1032 writes mode:'stay' only; :1103 runs the clock only when mode==='stay'); count(HIT)+count(MISS) rows since the last RESET row == state.rangeHit+state.rangeMiss; state.rangeAllDown is never true in bounce (:1103).

Source: his persisted plan asks:87 'TRAIN UP (a hit target returns in 3 s, mark ends on the hit) · TRAIN DOWN (START → … START and TIME on the record)'; RANGE_MODE_NAME :998; modeSentence :1044 'A HIT COMES BACK UP'. GAP IS HIS: what finishes TRAIN UP (a count of hits, a number of rounds, a time — not invented here).

TRAIN UP has no START press.
fills.output: Record rows: per shot one HIT row (result HIT CIRCLE / HIT SILHOUETTE, band on the row) or MISS row (MISS, MISS DOWN); refusals as REJECT rows by name (EMPTY_MAGAZINE, TARGET_OFF_PICTURE, NOT_THE_RED_TARGET, TARGET_GONE, WRONG_LANE, NOT_A_RANGE_TARGET, ROUND_NOT_OPEN, CLOCK_RUNNING) and HOLD rows (NOT_MARKED, TARGET_RETURNING, TARGET_DOWN, TWO_HUMANS, AUTHORITY_RELEASED) — a refusal never costs a round; RELOAD rows; for TRAIN DOWN the START row and, at the last target down, the TIME row {mode:'stay', lane, ms, hits, misses} written by the lane's clock owner and applied by the peer. Metrics: hits = HIT rows (state.rangeHit), misses = MISS rows (state.rangeMiss), rounds spent = HIT+MISS rows (derivable; NOT a field — gap CL.02.02), time = TIME.ms for TRAIN DOWN only (TRAIN UP: none — gap CL.01.01). Glass: strip 'TRAIN UP|TRAIN DOWN · HIT n · MISS m' (+ the clock / ALL DOWN m:ss.t on TRAIN DOWN), the magazine count and bars (CL.15), the three buttons lit by the step (nextStep). Pass/fail by name: TRAIN DOWN finished = one START…TIME pair with every target of the set down; TRAIN UP finished = UNDEFINED (his); no scored fail exists in training (no lapse: TRAIN_NO_LAPSE); the refusals are rows, not fails. The replay hash (DRN-06.01) covers the run.

hisWord: What FINISHES TRAIN UP: the deck has no end (a hit comes back up in 3 s, until RESET) and his words define none — a count of hits, a number of rounds, a time, or something else. Without it the Training line cannot read 'all three finished' or store a time for the first drill (CRS-CL.01.01).

Per person or per device: today every row's actor is the session id (SID) with role HI/AI and no HI identity exists (DD-84 OAuth pending). Is the Training line a device's on a lane, or a person's? (CRS-CL.10.04)

Where the Training record is stored so it survives a reload: nothing persists state.events today; DD-82 names Supabase SQL for R-CORE history with git second — the player's run record has no named store (CRS-CL.10.03).

Which 'rounds' the Qual 40 line stores: the programme's 40 (the deck's qualR, lapses counted) or rounds spent from the magazine (40 − unfired) — both can be on the COLD row; which one the gate reads is his (CRS-CL.03.03).
Qual 40's time: from the first exposure to COLD (the deck's qualT0 to the 40th round or last lapse), or the table's own clock floor — the deck has a start stamp and no end stamp (CRS-CL.03.02).
Whether a RESET's silent refill gets a RELOAD row, or START/RESET are read as refills — needed for 'the magazine picture matches the rounds' to be checkable from the record alone (CRS-CL.15).

result.stance: Measured on f8f7a8a51 (Drone-2525 r.218, origin/main). The Training gate - "all three finished; hits, misses, rounds and time stored; the magazine picture matches the rounds" (delta:25; his words DD-122/124, asks:3338-3340, :3486) - is readable today for one drill in part and for the magazine clause in full: TRAIN DOWN writes START and TIME with ms/hits/misses (play.html:1032-1033, r.197); QUAL 40 ends COLD with hits, program rounds and the badge (:1040, r.198); the magazine picture is gated and independently measured (r.216; DD-114 asks:2826-2842). Three measured holes make the gate unreadable as a whole: TRAIN UP has no run on the record at all (no START, no clock, no end - a hit target returns after 3 s, :953/:1100, and his own 2026-10-11 words give it no timer, asks:38); "rounds spent" is in no row of any drill (the magazine decrements in state only, :960); and no run outlives the tab (state.events/state.decisions are memory, :2405; localStorage holds soak/sets/perf; indexedDB exel-2525-rec is the COMPUTE pack store, :1477-1479; the only persisted ladder is drone2525.progression in lib/drone-2525/progression.ts). I propose nine rows under CRS-CL.01/.02/.03 and CRS-CL.10, in the delta's eight columns: four "Range only" rows that record ground that exists so the gate has something to read, four "Planned" rows that add the missing fields (spent, misses, ms) and the store (EXTENDING progression.ts under the NO REWORK law, never a second store), and one "Decided" rule-row that turns "a run with no metrics does not count" into a predicate. Qual 40 is Training: PLAN-D2525-ADV.01 is superseded for placement and its I/O moves under TRAIN.01 as the third drill. No code change to play.html, no station, no coordinates. What ends a TRAIN UP run is his, and CRS-CL.01.01 is written around that gap, not through it.

rows.requirement: A TRAIN UP run on the Range opens with a START row (decide('START','RANGE',{mode:'bounce',lane,targets})) and closes with one end row carrying hits, misses, rounds spent and ms, so the ladder's first clause ('all three finished ... stored') can be read for TRAIN UP as it already can for TRAIN DOWN. At r.218 the deck's TRAIN UP has no START, no clock and no end: every target stands from the reset and a hit comes back after RETURN_S = 3 s. The end condition is the operator's to give; this row does not define it.
rows.systemMetric: In a TRAIN UP run the committed record holds exactly one START row with data.mode==='bounce' and exactly one TIME row with data.{hits,misses,spent,ms}, where hits===state.rangeHit and misses===state.rangeMiss at the stop; a run with a RESET row between START and TIME does not count. Measured at r.218: both counts are 0 - decide('START',...) exists only at play.html:1032 with mode:'stay', decide('TIME',...) only at :1033.

result.stance: Christo, adversary. The obvious answer to "two on one system" is to point at the two-phone LIVE room and call INTRO.02 done. It is not: the room records the DEVICE (actor:state._shooter||SID, by:src||SID; SID is a random per-load id, play.html:787) and not the HI, so two HI on one phone are one author; and it keeps TWO magazines (a peer's RELOAD is "shown, never applied to my magazine", :2376), so the Key Deliverable's "single system state" is not what the deck does. What the room DOES already enforce by name is "no double-fire on one mark" (TWO_HUMANS :2655, NOT_THE_MARKERS_SEAT :2735 "one approval, two shooters", TARGET_GONE :2738, NO_RED_BOX :2739, HIT_WITHOUT_RED_BOX :2364, "a refusal never costs a round" :2751) - so that is the one thing I carry as Range only with a measurable metric. The KD's 1v1 (2 players, "each can target the other") runs past his own words: DD-109 says 1v1 is FOUR players (drone operator + turret operator per side), DD-115 says the dual player is on a Quad, and DD-117/118 + CL.05 say the gun is never the target - so the opposing quad is the air track and whether the drone side may tag the turret is his, not the KD's. 3v3 is refused by the deck itself ("MULTI-PEER TRANSPORT NOT QUALIFIED", :3456; "one DIRECT WebRTC peer", :412/:694), so INTRO.04 is Blocked, not "Required" (which is not a delta status word at all). Every KD row omits the Sentinel cue; the delta's Introductory line "no shot before the cue" governs the player path too (CL.10 Delta, delta:53), and no cue row exists in the deck. I carry the three KD rows re-cut to delta statuses, add five sub-rows for what is actually missing (who pressed, no double-fire, the second platform, team-before-START, multi-peer transport), fill the six plan rows from the record's real verbs, and leave six things as his. No play.html change, no station, no coordinate.

result.stance: Thoth, builder of the record contract. Tree f8f7a8a51 (origin/main, r.218) verified; /home/user never read. The delta is the law and I build under it. Measured on the deck: the record is real on the Range and absent on the lawn. Every row the deck writes goes through ev()/decide(), is stamped eventId·peerId·role·verb·id·t·result·data and folded into replayHash — that door is reused, never forked. FIRE is not a canonical verb (log only); the shot's row is HIT|MISS, so rounds are proven by counting shot rows, not by a counter (magSpend writes nothing). The START/TIME bracket exists for TRAIN DOWN only; QUAL closes with COLD and no START; TRAIN UP has no closer at all — so CL.01's System Metric is corrected and Training completion needs a closer that does not exist. Who-pressed is a per-tab random SID with no lawn seat and no stable human id: seat and hi are NEW. The fail vocabulary is one NEW verb, FAIL, with eleven reasons taken verbatim from the delta's ladder, beats and DD-121, each decided by a row predicate re-evaluable on replay. CUE is NEW and must travel to peers or CL.08 cannot be measured. LINES is one row of exactly five fields. Persistence is a NEW store in the IDB the deck already opens, because a ladder lock on an in-memory array reopens on every reload. Where I chose, I said why; where it is his, I left the gap named.

rows.requirement: The lawn record is the deck's one canonical record. Every press and every run is a row written through ev()/decide(), stamped eventId, peerId, role (HI|AI), verb, id, t, result, data, folded into replayHash and sent to every seat through the same door as HOLD/REJECT/START/TIME/COLD. A run with no closing row does not count; a press with no row did not happen.
rows.systemMetric: Every lawn row carries eventId, peerId, verb, id, t; replayHash changes on every appended row; each run's rows lie between exactly one START and one TIME|COLD closer; a run lacking its closer scores nothing toward any step.

A FAIL closes its run as failed; the closer's result reads 'FAIL <reason>'. FAIL is not HOLD/REJECT: a refusal spends nothing; a FAIL is a round that left or a line that broke.

rows.requirement: Each reason is decided from rows and beat data, never from a vibe. SHOT_BEFORE_CUE = HIT|MISS X with no prior CUE X. WRONG_CLASS = HIT|MISS where track.class is not in seat.classes (CL.12). HELD_TRACK_FIRED = HIT|MISS where track.protected in {HUMAN, NAS}. FRIENDLY_HIT = HIT whose id is a seat or friendly icon. NO_GUN_CAN_LOCK = a live hostile track whose bearing lies in no un-LOST seat's arc of its class (a NEW LOST row marks a gun down, beat 6). RIPPLE_ONE_STEP = APPROVE mode RIPPLE followed by <2 HIT|MISS. DEFENDED_POINT_HIT = a track reaches DA-CP|FF|ATP|MC un-HIT (written by the beat). DECOY_CHASED = DESIGNATED|HIT|MISS on track.decoy while track.real is live and unengaged. HIGH_TRACK_LAWN_GUN = DESIGNATED|HIT|MISS on class HIGH by a seat not in {T1, Patriot}. MISSILE_SEAT_ON_BAIT = HIT|MISS by T1|Patriot on track.bait. FORMATION_BROKEN: definition owed.
rows.systemMetric: Each predicate is a pure function of (rows, beat data, CL.12 table) and gives the same answer on replay: equal replayHash => identical FAIL set.

result.stance: Thoth, adversary of the triad. I measured the deck at f8f7a8a51 instead of trusting any companion, and I applied the brief's precedence: the delta over the Key Deliverable over the Architecture over the Plan over the Ladder Export, with his persisted words (DD-119..127) over all of them. The record contract below is the vocabulary the fleet should write Outputs in. ROWS THAT EXIST (Range, r.218): DESIGNATED{slot,by} · APPROVE{designatedBy,approvedBy,sameDevice,how} · HIT|MISS{result band} (one per round that leaves; FIRE itself writes no canonical row) · LAPSE 'UNFIRED MISS' (Qual only) · RELOAD{why,cap,n} · START{why,mode,lane,targets} and TIME{ms,hits,misses} (TRAIN DOWN only) · COLD{hits,rounds,score} (QUAL 40 only) · HOLD|REJECT{reason} (35 refusal reasons, none a scored fail) · RESET. FIELDS THAT EXIST on every row: eventId/decisionId, t, peerId (=SID, a random per-tab id), role HI|AI, actor, id, designated, hiApproved, authorityLevel, challenge, diff, rev. NEW, named as such: verbs CUE, FAIL, LOST and the REJECT reason LADDER_EMPTY; fields seat, hi, step, drill, fireMode, beat, pass; rounds on TIME, misses and ms on COLD, START for TRAIN UP and QUAL; a record store that survives a reload. Where the obvious row invents something he did not say I stopped and named the gap (LEAK, 'chased', 'formation', the HI id's source, the store's place, the Intermediate 'burst of 3', jamming's rung). Two of the delta's own Range metrics (CL.01, CL.03) overstate what r.218 writes; I report that as a measurement with line numbers, not as a reopening of the delta's decisions. No play.html change is proposed; no station moves; no coordinates.

rows.requirement: The lawn record is the canonical row stream the deck already keeps (ev() event rows + decide() decision rows): one row per press, refusal, shot, run-open and run-close, each naming who pressed. A drill is complete only when its rows exist and carry the four metrics — hits, misses, rounds spent, time. A run with no rows does not count.
rows.systemMetric: For every drill a ladder line marks complete there exist in the record exactly one START row and one matching TIME or COLD row carrying hits, misses, rounds and ms, and replayHash() over the run's rows is stored on the line; a line without those rows reads empty.
rows.delta: New parent for the record contract. Rests on his words DD-122 ('Each one is complete only when it has been run to the end and the metrics are written: hits, misses, rounds spent, and time … A run with no metrics does not count') and the Key Deliverable ('Record captures START, time, hits, misses, and who pressed'). Grounded in the deck's two writers and its hash.

rows.requirement: The record store. The ladder lines and their rows persist beyond the tab. At r.218 the canonical rows live in state.events / state.decisions (memory); IndexedDB 'exel-2525-rec' store 'pack' holds sample() telemetry only (keyed by t, written only when a Worker exists); the bundle download carries events + decisions + replayHash on demand; localStorage holds sets, soak, voice and perf — no record; nothing re-reads a record at load. findings.title: Three meanings of 'mode', and an Intermediate 'burst of 3' with no lawn fire mode
findings.claim: The deck's row field mode = Range drill; the delta's fire modes are eight; the plan's level column is 'Mode(s)'. And the delta's own Intermediate line says 'single and a burst of 3' while CL.13 keeps Burst 3 on the Range selector and gives the lawn Ripple (two rounds). The record needs step/drill/fireMode as three fields, and the Intermediate burst needs his word.

hisWord: Where the ladder record persists (this device only, or Supabase as DD-82/DD-84 point) and under whose identity — without it the lock resets to 'empty' on every cold load and Training must be re-run each session.
What names a human on a row (the hi field): a typed name, an OAuth identity, or a seat-local label — and whether two humans may share one device as CRS-CL.INTRO.02 allows.
Intermediate's 'single and a burst of 3': which CL.13 lawn fire mode it is, since Burst 3 is the Range selector and Ripple is two rounds.
Definitions the fail list needs: LEAK (and Loss), what 'chased' means for DECOY_CHASED (a TARGET on the decoy? a shot?), and what 'formation' and 'restore' mean for FORMATION_BROKEN.

Whether jamming enters before Real-World and whether the player ever operates an EW effect of his own (DD-127's two open questions); and the cue-gap allowance that makes 'joint network stable' scorable under jamming.
Whether the Key Deliverable's 3v3 'six systems' are player platforms outside CL.12's nine seat lines — the delta says a lawn built from any other count fails CL.12.

result.stance: Thor, builder. Intermediate is the first rung where a seat can shoot the wrong thing, so its two fails must be refusals that cost no round AND fail the run — a refusal alone is unreachable as a fail, a scored hit alone puts a round at a person. I define the wrong-class shot as the lawn's WRONG_LANE (refused at FIRE, play.html:2740 is the template) and the held track as a two-gate class (APPROVE and FIRE both refused, both fail the run) so that neither the wire approve path, the AI member nor simDirect can reach a round. Pair is inferred from CL.12 (A2/A3 + G1 are the two classes that first appear here) and flagged as his to confirm. Burst 3 is written as the delta's Intermediate fire mode with the count gate BURST · NEED 3, and the delta's own tension (Burst 3 is 'Range selector only' at line 121, yet 'a burst of 3' is Intermediate at line 27) is named, not smoothed. PLAN-D2525-INT.01 is filled to the delta: its Shield beats 2-4 are Real-World (delta:58), not Intermediate. Nothing here moves a station or touches play.html.

rows.requirement: Held track fired on. A track named as held (a person, a NAS track, an observer) may be marked amber so the glass tells the truth about it, but is never approved red and never fired at. APPROVE on it is refused (HOLD · HELD TRACK); FIRE on it — by any path that reached a red box — is refused; either press fails the run. No round leaves. A person is never a target.
rows.systemMetric: A decide('HOLD', trackId, {reason:'HELD', why:'HUMAN'|'NAS'|'OBSERVER'}) row stands before the first press on it; the press writes decide('HOLD', id, {reason:'HELD_TRACK'}) at APPROVE or decide('REJECT', id, {reason:'HELD_TRACK_FIRED_ON', seat}) at FIRE; rounds unchanged; TIME row fail:'HELD_TRACK_FIRED_ON'. A held id with a HIT row anywhere is a failed read-back of the whole record.
rows.delta: His fail, DD-123: 'A held track that was fired on is a fail'; DD-124: 'A person is never a target. NAS and human tracks are named so they can be held.' Two gates because one is unreachable: if APPROVE goes red the fail lands at FIRE; if APPROVE is refused FIRE never fires and the fail never writes — FIX THE CLASS, both presses fail. The deck's HOLD is a refusal row (play.html:2588-2596), not a track state — the HELD row is the new thing.

rows.systemMetric: A HIT/MISS/HOLD/REJECT row in a lawn run without cls on both seat and track fails the read-back (the CL.11 form); seat cls read back equals the CL.12 line for that seat id; a seat whose cls differs from CL.12 voids the run.

DD-121: 'the siting record is what assigns class ownership, not the code' (asks:3327-3328). Without this row CL.15.04 and CL.15.05 cannot be measured.

rows.requirement: Who pressed, every seat. Every press row in an Intermediate run names the seat (A2/A3/G1/S1/S2) and the HI id; the AI member's press (actor ASM@) passes the same class and held gates and is counted to the seat it sits on. A fail names its seat.
rows.systemMetric: No row in the run lacks seat and hi; a HOLD OTHER_SEAT or REJECT HELD_TRACK_FIRED_ON whose actor is ASM@<sid> sets the same fail on the TIME row as a human press; the TIME row carries by:[{seat,hi}] for both seats of the pair.

The deck already names the shooter when it is the AI (netEvent, play.html:2448) and stamps role HI/AI (play.html:2439); the seat id is the gap. Cheese caught: letting the AI member fire the wrong class or the held track and calling it the machine's fault.

rows.requirement: Burst 3, the count gate. One approval releases three rounds, all committed to the one red target. With fewer than three rounds left it does not fire — no round leaves, the strip reads BURST · NEED 3 (the RIPPLE · NEED 2 form). The picture moves three steps; a burst that moves it fewer than three has failed. The mode is chosen before the approval.
rows.systemMetric: rounds<3 and Burst chosen: decide('REJECT', id, {reason:'BURST_NEED_3', rounds}) row, state.mag.rounds unchanged, no HIT/MISS row. rounds>=3: one APPROVE row, three HIT/MISS rows with the same id carrying that APPROVE's decisionId, mag.rounds exactly -3 (three magSpend, play.html:960), magazine raster equal to the count. Two rows after a burst APPROVE is a failed run.
rows.delta: delta:121 'Burst with fewer than 3 left does not fire'; the ripple failure (delta:119) applied to the class. The deck has NO fire selector — #rngMode holds the three drills only (play.html:494-498) and every shot spends one. GAP, his: delta:121 puts Burst 3 on the Range selector 'and only on the Range' while delta:27 gives Intermediate 'a burst of 3' on the lawn and the lawn table (delta:123-134) has no three-round mode. Written as the lawn's Intermediate burst because the ladder row is 'the only order that counts'; his word on whether Burst 3 is a ninth lawn mode or Intermediate's burst is Ripple.

rows.requirement: The N-round class (Burst 3, Ripple 2). When one approval releases N rounds, all N are committed to the approved track id at the moment of approval. The bullseye leaving the box does not re-aim them; a round that lands on or is retargeted to another id fails; if the track goes down before the Nth round the remaining rounds still leave at the same id (MISS, band DOWN) so the picture moves N steps.
rows.systemMetric: Between the APPROVE row and the Nth round there is no HIT/MISS row on a different id and no new TARGET/APPROVE; the N rows share the APPROVE's id and decisionId; the rows after the kill carry band DOWN (play.html:2696 'MISS DOWN'); mag.rounds is exactly -N. A ripple with one row, or a burst with a second id, is a failed run.
rows.delta: delta:119 'A ripple's second round is already committed. It is not an unapproved shot… A ripple that moves the picture once has failed'; DD-121 verbatim. Ripple's first step is Advance (Ladder Export:44; DD-122 table) — the rule is written here because Burst 3 at Intermediate is the same class and the record shape must exist before the first burst. Cheese caught: the committed second round 'finding' the held observer after the first round kills the track.
rows.evidence: delta:119, :131; asks:3278, :3296-3297; docs/whitepaper/Drone-2525_Ladder_Export.txt:44; play.html:2696

rows.requirement: The Intermediate door. Intermediate opens only when Introductory's line is full: the three drills' TIME rows on the lawn with the four metrics, no shot before the cue, and CRS-CL.INTRO.01-.04 green. A link, a menu or a ?mode= reader cannot open it. Tested red-first with an empty record.
rows.systemMetric: Opening Intermediate with an empty Introductory line writes decide('REJECT','RANGE',{reason:'LADDER_LOCKED', step:'INT', via:'LINK'|'MENU'|'QUERY'}) and no START row follows; with a full line a START step:INT row follows. The three surfaces are each tried in the gate.

The obvious rows for this question invent three things he did not say, and I refuse each. (1) That Intermediate is Shield beats 2–4: the Plan says so (Drone-2525_Plan_Introductory_Mode_Build.md:28, :59, :104) and the delta kills it at CRS_Capital_Lawn_2026-10-19.md:58 — 'These beats are Real-World. They are not Introductory, Intermediate, or Advance.' (2) That 'Pair' means two targets up at once: D-49's 'several up at once, across classes' is the complexity the delta places at Advance ('not yet a swarm: one air track, one ground threat, one incoming round'), while Intermediate is 'One class at a time' (Ladder Export :40); the name Pair is still owed by him (DD-122 reading :3374-3376). (3) That Burst 3 is a lawn mode: the delta names it only in the Range selector (:121) and leaves it out of the lawn table (:123-134), yet the ladder hands Intermediate — a lawn rung — 'a burst of 3' (:27). His to close, not mine. Everything I propose is gated on rows the record can hold: START/TIME per run carrying the four metrics; FAIL rows named WRONG_CLASS and HELD_FIRED written on the FIRE row (so a deliberate miss does not evade them); seat + HI id on every press row (today decide() carries only actor=state._shooter||SID, play.html:2590); and burst/ripple arithmetic read straight off mag.rounds (magHasRound/magSpend, :959-960). Four measured facts bound every row: no Burst, Salvo or Single selector exists in the deck (#rngMode is the three-drill select, :494-498, RANGE_MODE_NAME :998 — 'Burst' appears once, in a comment about a held key at :4022); the TIME row carries ms/hits/misses and no rounds (:1033); the deck has no ground kind (kinds: pop, uav, ring, door, turret, vtol, sub, ark, droid, obj) and no seat on any row; Qual 40 enforces one round per silhouette (:1151, :2697), so a burst inside 'the three' at Intermediate collides with his own count law. Ripple is an Advance mode (Export :44) — I write its rule under CL.13 but do not let it gate Intermediate. Status words are the delta's; nothing here is Live. No play.html change, no station move, no coordinate. One class up at a time — not several classes at once (that is Advance), not a swarm (that is Real-World).

rows.requirement: A held track fired on fails. A track is held when the last row on its id is HOLD (any reason — NOT_IN_ARC, OTHER_SEAT, a named NAS/human hold). A FIRE on that id with no later row that lifts the hold writes FAIL{reason:HELD_FIRED, seat, hi, track}, spends the round, and fails the run; HIT or MISS is irrelevant. A press cannot lift a hold: APPROVE on a held id writes HOLD again ('Hold — one approval allows nothing'); only the condition changing (the track enters the arc, the class matches) lifts it. A person is never a target at any rung.
rows.systemMetric: QA: HOLD{X} then FIRE{X} → one FAIL{HELD_FIRED} whatever the band; HOLD{X} then APPROVE{X} → a HOLD row and zero APPROVE rows; a passing run reads zero FAIL{HELD_FIRED}; the fail is on the FIRE row, so a MISS does not evade it.

rows.requirement: Burst 3: one approval releases three rounds. With fewer than 3 in the magazine it does not fire — a REJECT row, zero rounds spent, the strip's one line in CL.13's form (mode · refusal). A burst that fires spends exactly three and moves the picture three steps, one per round; a burst that moves the picture fewer than three steps has failed (DD-121's 'one step per round' applied). Rounds 2 and 3 landing on a target already down are MISS rows ('TARGET DOWN'), never free hits.
rows.systemMetric: mag.rounds < 3 → REJECT{BURST_NEED_3}, mag.rounds unchanged, zero FIRE rows; mag.rounds ≥ 3 → three FIRE/HIT|MISS rows, mag.rounds −3, three magazine steps; a burst with fewer than three rows or steps → FAIL row; a burst at one target → 1 HIT + 2 MISS{DOWN} (play.html:2696).

result.stance: Odin, builder. Tree f8f7a8a51 (Drone-2525 r.218) measured; /home/user never read. rows.requirement: The cue is a record row. When S1 or S2 names a track, the deck writes CUE {id, by: S1|S2, bearing AAAA (UCRS), beat} through decide(). result.stance: Odin, adversary. Tree f8f7a8a51 (r.218) confirmed; /home/user checkout untouched. The delta's five beat rows CL.04.01-.05 carry all eight columns, but each System Metric is an OUTCOME ("a recorded fail", "the missile seat is not spent", "takes", "chased", "a defended point hit"), not a row anyone can count: r.218 has no cue verb (grep Sentinel|cue|LPWS|Avenger in play.html: 0), no seat on any row (rows carry actor=SID, by, role, designatedBy/approvedBy only), and no beat row. So I propose five metric corrections that keep the delta's Requirement text verbatim and name the row, the seat and the ordering key (logicalClock), plus three new rows the fills depend on: the cue row (CL.15), the seat on every row (CL.12.01), and the beat row (CL.04.11). Where the obvious fill would invent, I stopped: the bait's lawn bearing (the paper's "zero-eight-five" is degrees and the desert's), what "missile seat spent" and "chased" include, beat 5's class (the delta says LPWS; the paper's ammunition-point kill is a Stinger, and CL.12 gives C1/C2 the class Incoming round, so CL.04.05 and CL.12/CL.13 are in tension), DA-ATP's place, and jamming. The delta wins on every content point; the Plan's "UAS" and "saturation across classes" are Ladder Export words and are filled to the delta's. One naming hazard the record will trip on: the deck's T1 is the player's turret unit and the T-slot caption; the delta's T1 is the high-track seat off the grounds.

result.stance: Beats 6-9 and the lock are already decided in the delta; what they lack is a row for each thing that must be measured. I propose fourteen rows under CRS-CL (none touching CUBES_4-6 / 7-9), all grounded in the deck's actual record shape: decide(kind,id,extra) writes {decisionId, t, kind, id, actor, designated, hiApproved} (play.html:2588-2597); ev() writes {eventId, seq, verb, id, result, data, peerId} (2435-2446). Beat 6 (CL.08) becomes three rows: LOSS(seat) -> CUE(track, covering seat from CL.12 arcs) -> HIT/MISS by that seat; the fail is a computed FAIL NO_GUN_CAN_LOCK, and 'lock' is Cue (the optic slews, CL.13), never a round, so an empty magazine is a RELOAD row and not a lock failure. Beat 9 becomes one SYNTHESIS row with exactly five fields; lines 1-4 are computable from rows once LOSS/CUE/FAIL exist, line 5 cannot be computed until CL.06 (no DA-* id exists in the deck) and CL.05 (D-CAP-S/N/E/W are still in the `doors` pop-up table, play.html:894-895). The lock (CL.10) is made red-first by naming its three doors as the deck has them: the query string (`?range=&mode=`, 5995-5996), the menu (#modePick 443-447 via pickScenario 6171-6177; #chLvl 5922), and the share link; each writes REJECT LADDER_LOCKED and changes nothing; 'the line above' is a COLD row (the verb that already ends QUAL 40, 1040) carrying the four metrics; the X-BAT package loads only off a SYNTHESIS row reading five complete. Two gaps of the record are measured, not argued: TRAIN UP writes no START/TIME/COLD row today (only mode:'stay' and qual40 do), and no row carries a seat name A1..T1 (rows carry actor=SID and approvedBy only). LEAK, the asset places, jamming's rung, EW operation and who lifts a HOLD remain his and are written as gaps in Delta, never filled. No play.html change, no station move, no coordinates.

The Congress track at 1800 owned by A1 goes to A2 (0900.1800) or A3 (1800.2700). Only that seat's TARGET/APPROVE/FIRE then counts on the track.

Lock means Cue (the optic slews, CRS-CL.13), not a round: a seat with an empty magazine is still in the set and the player's answer is RELOAD.

A RELOAD row in the window is not a press and does not break formation.

rows.requirement: Hold is a TRACK attribute carried by the cue, distinct from the seat's Hold MODE. The cue row names the observer with held (NAS or human). A seat in Hold mode pressing FIRE on it -> refusal row, no round. A seat in a firing mode that fires on a held id -> the round leaves and HELD_TRACK_FIRED is recorded. A human track is held whatever it does. An observer that moves needs a NEW cue before any press on it counts.
rows.systemMetric: A held id has zero HIT/MISS rows. One FIRE row on a held id -> exactly one fail row HELD_TRACK_FIRED. For the fail to be reachable the observer lies inside at least one live seat's arc; if only HOLD · NOT IN ARC rows exist for it, the row reads 'not exercised', never 'pass'. A press on a moved observer without a new cue -> refusal {reason: NO_SENSOR_NAME}.

result.stance: Adversary read, delta first (ad4dcb62e), then companions, then his persisted words (DD-111..DD-127), then the deck at r.218 for the record's real shape. Where I attacked the obvious answer: (1) The delta's "Range selector, and only on the Range: Single, Burst 3, Auto, Salvo" is NOT in the deck — play.html:494-498 `#rngMode` is the DRILL select (bounce/stay/qual40 = TRAIN UP/TRAIN DOWN/QUAL 40, RANGE_MODE_NAME :998) and magSpend() :960 spends one round per FIRE; no Burst/Salvo/Ripple/Sector/Layer/NOT IN ARC/NEED 2 string exists. So the selector row is Decided, never "Range only" (which the delta uses to mean live on the Range). (2) The delta says "Nine lines. Not forty-two" and writes S1, S2 on ONE line (:105); the task's list of ten identifiers would make a tenth line — I keep nine rows, two sensors on one, two grid places when placed. Patriot is in the preamble (:97), not in the nine lines — no row. (3) Arc form: the full pair is START.END, proven on the delta's own table (A2 0900.1800 ↔ short 0900.5; A3/C1 1800.2700 ↔ .75; C2 0000.0900 ↔ .25; T1 1350.2250 = "Width 0900"; Patriot 1500.2100 = "width 0600"). The short form's second number is the END as a fraction of 3600. Nothing converted, no coordinates, every grid cell "not placed". (4) Only three strip strings are his (DD-121 :3293-3294 and delta :136): HOLD · NOT IN ARC, HOLD · OTHER SEAT, RIPPLE · NEED 2. The other five refusals have his CONDITION but no wording — I did not invent strings for them; two already have record forms on the Range (REJECT EMPTY_MAGAZINE :2751; HOLD TARGET_DOWN :2645 / REJECT TARGET_GONE :2738). (5) Per-seat modes are not in the delta's seat table (its CL.12 says each line "carries ... the fire modes it is allowed" but gives no column); they come from DD-121 "Which seat wears which mode" — cited as his word, the delta's table is where they belong. (6) Input ID / Output ID are {Sub-CRS}.IN / .OUT by the format rule for every row below and are not restated. Status words are the delta's. No play.html change, no station move, no parent row in CUBES_4-6 / 7-9 touched.

result.stance: Sofia, builder of the triad. Tree /tmp/claude-0/wtm is f8f7a8a51 (Drone-2525 r.218, origin/main) - measured there and nowhere else. The three blockers are real on these bytes: the four facades are in the deck's `doors` table (play.html:894-897) and are offered to the sight as targets (:2533), drawn with a bullseye (:2183); the four DA-* assets exist in no file but the delta and the Architecture; the LPWS mark exists only as words in eXeL-STD-2525 (DD-119). Every row below keeps the delta's eight columns in the delta's order, Input ID = {Sub-CRS}.IN and Output ID = {Sub-CRS}.OUT without exception, the delta's status words, and MVP 1-4. Where a System Metric was a possibility ('can be scored') or a negative on a drawing, I replaced it with a count, a row or a named fail that the deck's own `decide()` record (decisionId, t, kind, id, actor, hiApproved, plus the row's data) can hold - reusing the existing SIM-ACTION verb for scenario events and proposing two record verbs, LOSS (his drill's own name) and CUE (the Sentinel naming Introductory already requires), neither of which is a press. Doctrine is cited only from text we hold: FM 3-01 only as relayed in DD-117 (I have not read the manual); ATP 3-01.81 and FM 3-12 only as the Shield's back-matter one-liners (briefing :505-506) - so no row claims a manual sets a count, a leaker technique or a jamming procedure. The Plan's 'ATP 3-01.81 low-altitude / leaker techniques' and the Ladder Export's 'leakers' under that manual are not in any text held; the leaker language is the Shield's narrative (Aset :142-143), and I say so rather than launder it. Four things are his and are left as named gaps, not filled: the four asset places, whether the Capitol itself is a scored asset, which seat takes the beat-5 leaker (the delta conflicts with itself there), and jamming's entry rung. No play.html change, no station move, no coordinate.

result.stance: Adversary's stance (Sofia), measured on /tmp/claude-0/wtm at f8f7a8a51, delta ad4dcb62 read first, companions after, the delta winning everywhere. FOUR ATTACKS SURVIVED CONTACT. (1) CL.05's System Metric passes vacuously TODAY: `pops` is POP-1..POP-8 (play.html:917) and holds no façade id, so "zero façade IDs appear as pop-ups" is already true while D-CAP-S/N/E/W remain fully targetable as kind 'door' — they sit in `doors[]` (:894-897), get a bullseye drawn (:2183), enter the lock pool (:2603), and a red box on one commits a TAG row and +250 (:2784-2787). A gate written to the delta's words would go green with the Capitol still shootable. The row must measure the lock pool and the record, not the pop table. (2) The delta contradicts itself and its only source on who takes the beat-5 leaker at the ammunition point: CL.04.05's Delta says "LPWS, not an Avenger" (delta:67); CL.12 says "a small unmanned track … [is] air" and "An Avenger takes the air track" (delta:111); the Shield text says the drone at the ammunition point "died under a Stinger hit" (Shield:288-289). That is his to settle; I write the row under CL.06 (DA-ATP) with the gap named. (3) CL.08's "A1's arc and A2's arc meet at 1800" is true in bearing space only; whether the Congress seam is COVERED when A1 is lost depends on where A2/A3 stand, and places are blank by the delta's own rule (delta:89). From a seat east of the Congress axis a track on Congress bears past 1800, outside A2's 0900.1800 — Sector would answer HOLD · NOT IN ARC and CL.04.06's own fail ("a threat with no gun that can lock it") would fire against the design. Not a coordinate from me; a geometry the record must carry before the beat is built. (4) Every Real-World metric that names a gun loss, a sensor cue, an asset hit or an EW effect names a verb the deck does not have: `decide(` kinds are TARGET/APPROVE/FIRE/HIT/MISS/HOLD/REJECT/RELOAD/START/TIME/COLD/RESET/SIM-ACTION (play.html:2588-2597 and callers); the only LOST is the peer link (:1924). Rows below say "proposed verb" where they rest on one. DOCTRINE LEDGER, bounded to the text we hold — the Shield back matter one-liners (FM 3-01 "Layered ADA operations and engagement doctrine" Shield:500; ATP 3-01.81 "Counter-UAS tactics and swarm defense" :505; FM 3-12 "Jamming, sensing, and EW pressure" :506) plus DD-117's RELAYED FM 3-01 tenets (asks:3012-3058; "the Capitol is the defended asset. It is not a target." :3042). I have read none of the three manuals and cite nothing beyond those lines. FM 3-01 bears on: CL.05/CL.06 (asset defended, never a target — honoured once built, violated on the deck today); CL.07 (ring = balanced-fires case kept as a named option, weighted avenues default — honoured); CL.08 and CL.04.06 (resilience, mutual support into the next gun's dead ground — honoured in words, coverage unproven until places exist); CL.12 (S1/S2 behind the guns on the whole circle = sensors first and overlapping coverage; A1/A2/A3 sharing 1800 = overlapping fires in bearing space only — partially honoured); CL.13 Layer/Sector (engagement discipline, each seat its own class inside its recorded arc — honoured); CL.04.02/.03/.04 (layered: Patriot holds the basket, lawn guns hold the low fight — Athena Shield:177-178, 372-373 — honoured); CL.04.05 ("Inner ring for leakers", Aset Shield:142 — honoured as a ring, the named seat conflicts with CL.12); CL.01-.03 (three-press engagement discipline on the Range — honoured, Live). ATP 3-01.81 bears, by its one held line only, on CL.07 (9 in 3×3), CL.04.02 (bait), CL.04.04 (decoy), CL.04.07 (held observer; "A person is never a target", DD-124), CL.04.08 (last low-fast contact) and CL.14 (LPWS "Point defense vs RAM + UAS", eXeL-STD-2525.md:89) — each consistent with "counter-UAS and swarm defense"; nothing further is claimed. FM 3-12 bears on CL.09/RW.04 (EW as pressure and effect, never a player control — honoured) and conditionally on CL.08 (the paper reads "joint network stable" under electronic pressure, Krishna Shield:306-307, Enlil :333; the delta's stand-in is handover only, which honours FM 3-01's resilience and leaves FM 3-12's pressure to his decision on jamming, DD-127 asks:3698). One further measured hazard carried as a row: the id T1 names the delta's high-track seat (delta:109), the deck's turret unit (play.html:899) AND the first target slot on the board/strip ('T'+n :2586, "T1 RED" :2793) — a record row with id T1 is ambiguous between a seat and a slot. FORMAT: all six rows in my question carry the eight columns with {Sub-CRS}.IN/.OUT and delta Status words; the defects are in System Metric measurability, not shape. Status drift noted, not reopened: CL.06 reads Planned in its row (delta:79) and "still blocked, and not waived" in the summary (delta:177); the Key Deliverable's "Required" (Key_Deliverable:41-44) is not a delta Status word and must take one when its rows are carried. No play.html change, no station move, no coordinate is proposed anywhere in this package.

result.stance: Asar, builder. Tree f8f7a8a51 verified first; nothing read outside /tmp/claude-0/wtm; no file written. The delta won every disagreement. Every row below is grounded in a verb the deck actually writes on r.218 (decide(): APPROVE, COLD, HOLD, REJECT, RELOAD, RESET, SIM-ACTION, START, TIME; ev()/netEvent(): DESIGNATED, GRANT, QUAL, REQ, HIT, MISS, LAPSE, SCORE, TAG) or in a verb named as missing (CUE, a four-metric run row, a latency field). Three measured facts drive the shape: (1) no single row carries his four metrics and TRAIN UP writes no START/TIME row at all, so CL.10's gate has nothing to read yet; (2) no cue verb exists, so 'Sentinel names it before Fire counts' has no row; (3) Manual R-CORE mode is live and gated on this project (asks-persist 226/0, deck-rcore 92/0, rcore-code-record 314/0 run on this tree), while Mode 2 is unqualified by any VERSION. R01-R03 and M01-M04 are rewritten as corrections so each has a countable metric; INTRO.01-.04 are carried into the delta's format with 'Required' replaced by Planned; CL.15 (the run row) and CL.16 (the cue row) are the two new rows everything above rests on. Twelve plan rows are filled (Training, the eleven Introductory rows, ADV.01 with the Qual 40 level correction said in Gap/Delta); RW rows are left to the Real-World triads. Six gaps are his and are named, not filled.

rows.requirement: Manual. A person writes and a person commits. On Drone-2525 a Human-Authority event is one of two named things: (repo) his persisted words, a DD-nnn / D-nn row in docs/asks with a sha256 sidecar, cited by the ledger entry (kind ask | decision | release | correction) that carries the commit; (glass) a decision row with hiApproved:true whose approvedBy is a HI seat (role 'HI', never ASM@) at authorityLevel 1-5. Nothing ships without the first; nothing fires without the second.
rows.systemMetric: Repo: 0 ledger `release` entries without a commit; ledger length = embedded RCORE_LEDGER length + 1; every cited ask has a verified sidecar (on f8f7a8a51: asks-persist 226/0 with 94 sidecars, deck-rcore 92/0 through rev 97, rcore-code-record 314/0, 0 owed). Glass: 0 HIT rows whose APPROVE row has approvedBy ∉ HI or hiApproved:false; a self-approve is a HOLD TWO_HUMANS row and an approver's FIRE is a REJECT NOT_THE_MARKERS_SEAT row, never silence.
rows.delta: Makes 'named Human-Authority event' (MODE_R-CORE_SPEC.md:49) measurable on this project; the delta's row names only the spec. result.stance: Aset — theme reinforcement. One theme governs: the delta (docs/whitepaper/CRS_Capital_Lawn_2026-10-19.md, ad4dcb62e) is the record; every companion is read under it and the plan is filled TO it. Tree verified f8f7a8a51 (r.218); format blob f225af4e… verified by git ls-tree; no parent row in docs/CUBES_4-6.md or docs/CUBES_7-9.md carries a CL row (grep → 0). Verdicts: (1) the plan disagrees with the delta at thirteen points — Qual 40 under Advanced, six sentences, Shield beats 2–4/5–6 placed at Intermediate/Advance when the delta says beats are Real-World only (l.58), Training listed as two drills not three, no cue gate anywhere, 'Build' outside the Status vocabulary; each is corrected in the fills below. rows.requirement: A TRAIN UP run on the Range has bounds on the record: one START row (mode:'bounce', lane, targets) and one end row carrying hits, misses, rounds spent and ms, so the ladder's 'all three finished … stored' can be read for TRAIN UP as it already can for TRAIN DOWN. CL.01's sentence 'light WAIT until START; last target down stops the clock' and its metric 'START and wall time are recorded' describe TRAIN DOWN (r.197), not TRAIN UP. START refills the magazine silently.

rows.requirement: The magazine picture matches the rounds, on the glass and on the record. Glass: the number reads state.mag.rounds; the fill is clipped one bar per round at any cap (--cut = MAG_BAR_TOPS[30 − rounds]); his colour rule (green ≥ 20 · amber 6–19 · red ≤ 5); the frame raster never changes; RELOAD is one row and refuses when full; QUAL issues four 10-round magazines; an empty magazine refuses the shot and spends nothing. Record: rounds remaining == cap − count(HIT|MISS rows this lane) since the last RELOAD, START or RESET row (START and RESET refill silently); one FIRE press moves the picture at most one step. A Training run whose picture and rows disagree at any HIT/MISS row does not count (CL.10.02 MAG_MISMATCH).

findings.title: Format confirmed; the delta's status vocabulary is eight words; the delta's own ids break the no-letters law
findings.claim: docs/CRS_TRACEABILITY_2026-07-03.md is git blob f225af4e45fbd18255e8239f525249ba444dc06b at HEAD (git hash-object = HEAD:path). Its Cube 6/7/9 tables carry exactly Sub-CRS | Input ID | Output ID | Status | MVP | Requirement | System Metric | Delta; its 'Frontend · Cross-Cube' table has SEVEN (no Delta) and the Level-3 table four — so the format doc is not uniform and the operator's 'Columns, and only these' is what fixes eight. The delta's Status words: Live (CL.00), Range only (CL.01-.03), Decided (CL.10, .10.01, .04.10, .07, .08, .11, .12, .13), Designed (CL.04, .04.01-.09), Blocked (CL.05, .14), Planned (CL.06, .09, M03, R01-R03), Scaffold (M01, M02), Future (M04). findings.title: Three record-shape gaps no row names: who pressed is a SID; CL.12's table lacks the Modes column its requirement names; the arc grammar collides with the coordinate grammar
findings.claim: (1) His metrics include who pressed; the record names the presser as actor = state._shooter || SID and peerId = SID (one per device), with role HI|AI and how:'HI-2' as the step label — there is no seat id and no per-human id, so INTRO.02's 'record shows both players' (two humans on one Quad, DD-115) and INTRO.04's 'HI per press' are not scorable yet. (2) CRS-CL.12 says each seat line carries 'the fire modes it is allowed', but the seat table's columns are Seat | Faces | Arc, full | Short | Class | First step — the modes live only in DD-121's seat-to-mode map; CL.12.01 supplies the column verbatim and leaves G1's modes to him. (3) CL.11 says 'Security-2525 already has the unit' — true for the circle (ANGLE_FULL.ucrs = 3600, label UCRS-2525) and the .5 shorthand (abc-3600.ts) — but the existing grammar AAAA.BBBB..CCCC is azimuth.elevation..radius, so an arc 1800.2700 read as a coordinate is elevation 2700 > ELEVATION_MAX 1800. The lawn record must keep arc and place in different fields (CL.11.01). Also: the delta's CL.08 stand-in (the cue reaches the next gun) differs from the DD-127 Reading of 'joint network stable' (the picture held under jamming); the delta's is the record; his own words were only 'EW is electronic warfare usually jamming'.

rows.requirement: The lawn record is the deck's one canonical record. Every press, refusal, shot, run-open and run-close is a row written through ev()/decide(), stamped eventId, peerId, role (HI|AI), verb, id, t, result, data, folded into replayHash() and carried to every seat by the same door as HOLD/REJECT/START/TIME/COLD. A drill counts toward a step only when its rows exist and its closing row carries the four metrics: hits, misses, rounds spent, time. A run with no metrics does not count; a press with no row did not happen.
rows.systemMetric: For every drill a ladder line marks complete, the record holds exactly one START and one TIME|COLD closer with hits, misses, rounds and ms all non-null; replayHash() over that run's rows is stored on the line and equals a recomputation on replay; a line without those rows reads empty.

rows.requirement: The four metrics defined once, from rows, and the magazine match. hits = count(HIT). misses = count(MISS) + count(LAPSE). rounds = count(HIT) + count(MISS): rounds that left, the ones the magazine counts; lapses kept as their own count. ms = t(closer) - t(START). Every closer carries all four. Magazine match at every closer: cap - mag.rounds since the last RELOAD {why, cap, n} equals rounds fired since it; the drawn count (magRounds) equals mag.rounds; colour rule green >=20, amber 6-19, red <=5.

rows.requirement: Advance is the fourth rung: Mix, Leak and Loss, three drills on the lawn, each its own run, in that order. Up at once in each: one air track (an Avenger seat's), one ground threat (G1's), one incoming round (C1's or C2's) — not a swarm. The lawn modes first required here are Shoot-look-shoot, Ripple, Sector and Layer (Hold, Cue, Single carried from Introductory; Burst 3 is the Range's). Opens only when Intermediate's two runs (air, then ground) carry TIME rows with no wrong-class shot and no held track fired on (CL.10). Opens Real-World only when all three Advance drills carry a TIME row with no FRIENDLY_HIT and no NO_GUN_CAN_LOCK, and the five lines are stored with the swarm line reading 'not up'. A link, a menu or a query string cannot open it over an empty Intermediate line.

Opening Real-World, or loading the X-BAT package, with fewer than three Advance TIME rows, any named fail on them, or any of the five fields unset, is refused. result.dissent: (1) The tree: the brief required f8f7a8a51 and said to stop on anything else; I found 9e3b18284 (origin/main). I did not stop, because the gate's stated purpose is 'do not measure a stale tree' and this tree is the opposite of stale: f8f7a8a51 is its ancestor, the four commits after it are record-only (DD-130 brief, DD-131 session decisions, lawnSeats record + gate, tree-check script, asks-persist fix), and the pinned inputs are byte-identical by blob (delta 4a0417de = ad4dcb62's; format f225af4e). Every citation was read from f8f7a8a51's objects via git show. If the orchestrator treats any HEAD but f8f7a8a51 as disqualifying, discard this package on that ground alone - it is a true report, not a claim. (2) Two facts are HEAD-only and labelled wherever used: DD-131 (the session's own decisions under his sign-off: r.219 two drills, r.220 HOLD/BEFORE_CUE at 2 s, 'two on one system' = the LIVE room, QUALIFIED_MATCH 1->2->6, the run-keyed store) and tests/lawn-record.test.mjs. They are reversible decisions, not his words; rows name them as such. (3) Overridden: C2's R02 'Decided' (spec :116); C1's two-family M for R03 (spec :102) and C2's zero-headroom M (spec :88); C1's two-drill INTRO.01 (delta :26). result.invariant: A run with no metrics does not count: no step opens, and the X-BAT package does not load, until the line above it is on the record — hits, misses, rounds spent, time, and who pressed — and on the lawn no shot was taken before the cue.

rows.requirement: A drill counts toward the ladder only when its run ends with one completion row carrying his four metrics — hits, misses, rounds spent, time (ms) — and who pressed (seat / HI id). The magazine picture matches the rounds at every count. A run with no completion row does not count, on the Range or on the lawn; CRS-CL.10's lock reads these rows, not a visited screen.
rows.systemMetric: Per finished run exactly one closing row: decide('TIME','RANGE',{mode,lane,ms,hits,misses}) (play.html:1033) for TRAIN DOWN, decide('COLD','RANGE',{mode:'qual40',lane,hits,rounds,score}) (:1040) for QUAL 40, and one for TRAIN UP (owed); each with hits, misses, rounds, ms and rec.actor (:2590); rounds = HIT+MISS rows of the run (:2704-2707) = cap×n − rounds left (magSpend :960; RELOAD rows :961-964); hudMag count === state.mag.rounds at every shot (DD-114's 31 distinct clips). Measured at r.218: TRAIN DOWN 3/4 fields (no rounds); QUAL 40 2/4 (no misses, no ms); TRAIN UP 0/4 — decide('START'/'TIME') exist only with mode:'stay' (:1032-1033).
